verdict.rationale: TruffleHog documents its own event-driven actions: findings can be routed to Slack, Jira, email, or webhooks, and alerts with customized developer messages can be set up while it continuously tracks key status. There is no documented general-purpose rules engine for defining conditions and arbitrary actions, and the pre-commit blocking relies on Git's hook mechanism. Missing for 10: user-definable conditional rules (event filters, triggers, action chains), detailed docs on alert rule configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
